comparison.objective: Mount the final tire-bead section using drop-center slack; candidate registers and secures proximity switches.
comparison.physical_skill: Bimanual deformable bead compression/rolling versus rigid mounted-component adjustment with a screwdriver.
comparison.success_condition: Bead seated, valve aligned, no damaging lever use or strike; candidate requires two ≤6 mm sensed endpoints and tightened mounts.
comparison.reason: The objectives, physics, and failure modes are unrelated. Candidate still needs exact rigid component geometry and tightening limits.
